fastpath_ring_buffer.synchronization_protocol: Lock-free single-producer single-consumer (SPSC) with acquire/release memory barriers

producer_head_idx.role: Written exclusively by AOP2 hardware/firmware upon sample generation

consumer_tail_idx.role: Written exclusively by host Darwin kernel AppleSPUFastpathDriver upon draining

dropped_samples_counter.role: Overrun counter incremented when head catches tail

ambient_light_sensor.conversion_formula: lux = ((clear_counts - ir_counts * ir_rejection_factor) * lux_coefficient * gain_multiplier) / integration_time_ms

hardware_buffer_properties.resolution: Partial update rectangle (e.g. 460x120 pixels for status/clock elements)

always_on_display.direct_path: AOP2 writes directly to DCP frame buffer via shared DMA; host GPU and display engine remain completely powered down.

acoustic_parameters.storage_location: AOP2 Dedicated Low-Power Retention SRAM Carveout

wake_trigger_sequence: 1. Low-power PDM/I2S mic feeds continuous 16kHz audio stream into AOP2 SRAM circular FIFO.
2. On-chip lightweight acoustic model executes VAD (Voice Activity Detection) and Keyword Spotting (KWS).
3. Upon keyword trigger detection, AOP2 asserts host wake doorbell (spu_wake_reason: voice_trigger).
4. Host AppleAOPAudio retrieves the 3.0-second historical audio buffer to provide seamless pre-trigger acoustic context to CoreSpeech.
